title: Readers accept unknown history events: lint warns instead of List/Get failing, so newer event kinds do not make older adj binaries refuse a store
lead:
Readers accept a history entry whose event this binary does not know, and
unknown keys inside a history entry, and keep both when the record is
rewritten; `adj lint` warns about them instead of `List`/`Get` failing. Then
a later event kind (as `import` was in S22, or `amend` with its new `was` key)
does not make an older `adj` refuse a store. Must land before the 1.0 JSON
freeze (S39).

Not in this slice: unknown top-level record keys (they stay refused by
`DisallowUnknownFields`, owner 2026-10-19); unknown statuses; the JSON freeze
itself (S39); the `--json` error object (S42); a change to `adj ai`.
findings_note: Split from S39 owner note (from S22, 2026-10-18): must land before the 1.0 JSON freeze.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decision 2026-10-18 (S39 note, from S22): before freezing, make readers
accept unknown history events, lint warning instead of List/Get failing.
Owner decisions 2026-10-19: scope is unknown event names AND unknown keys
inside a history entry (top-level record keys stay strict); a record with an
unknown event is still writable by this binary (decide, reject, withdraw,
amend, supersede, renumber), and the unknown entry and its unknown keys
round-trip unchanged.

Today `model.Parse` decodes with `DisallowUnknownFields`
(internal/model/file.go:79), which also applies inside `history`, and
`Record.Validate` refuses an event that `Event.Valid` does not list
(internal/model/record.go:208).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/model/record.go: `HistoryEntry` keeps unknown keys (for example an
  unexported or `json:"-"` map of `json.RawMessage`) with its own
  `UnmarshalJSON`/`MarshalJSON`, so the top-level `DisallowUnknownFields`
  stays strict but entry keys are kept; known keys keep their current names,
  order and omitempty behaviour, unknown keys are written after them in
  sorted key order (deterministic bytes). `Validate`: an unknown but
  non-blank event is no longer an error; a blank event still is; the `was`
  rules (amend needs `was`; only amend has `was`) apply to known events only,
  so an unknown event may carry `was`. Keep the date rule for every entry.
  Provide a way for lint to ask "is this event known" (keep or rename
  `Event.Valid`; record the choice as a C32 decision).
- internal/model/file.go: nothing beyond what the entry type needs; top-level
  unknown keys still fail.
- Anything that compares `HistoryEntry` values (renumber stale-copy matching,
  internal/store/renumber.go and internal/lint/lint.go, C163/C181; tests) must
  still compile and compare unknown keys too: two entries differing only in an
  unknown key are not equal.
- internal/lint/lint.go: new warning checks, added to `Checks`:
  `unknown-event` (one finding per entry: `history entry N: unknown event
  "X"`) and `unknown-history-key` (one per entry, naming its unknown keys in
  sorted order). Warnings only, so lint still exits 0 on them alone.
- internal/render: `adj show` text prints the stored event name as it does
  today; `--json` output includes an entry's unknown keys (they are part of
  the record). Whether text `show` prints unknown keys is an implementer
  decision (C32); recommend not printing them.
- docs/json.md: history entries may have events and keys this version does
  not know; readers must ignore them; lint check list gains the two checks.
- AGENTS.md (adj lint entry, model notes), PROJECT.md (data model: history
  events; lint checks), README.md (lint checks, if listed), CHANGELOG.md
  `## Unreleased`: the new tolerance and the two lint checks.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Write these first and watch each fail for the stated reason:

- model: `Parse`/`Unmarshal` of a record with a history entry
  `{"date": ..., "event": "future-thing", "note": "x"}` succeeds (today:
  unknown event error).
- model: an entry with an unknown key (`"by": "someone"` on a `decide` entry,
  and on an unknown event) parses (today: unknown field error), and
  `Marshal` writes it back; parse, marshal, parse gives an equal record and
  the second marshal is byte-identical to the first.
- model: an unknown top-level key still fails to parse (regression guard).
- model: a blank event still fails `Validate`; an unknown event with `was`
  validates; `amend` without `was` and `decide` with `was` still fail.
- model/commands: decide (and amend) on an open record whose history holds an
  unknown event with an unknown key succeeds and the file keeps that entry
  and key unchanged, plus the new entry.
- store: `List` and `Get` succeed on such a store (today: fail).
- lint: such a store gives one `unknown-event` and one
  `unknown-history-key` warning with the expected messages, exit 0;
  `--json` lists them with severity `warning`.
- render/cli: `adj show --json` includes the unknown key in the entry;
  `internal/cli/jsonshape_test.go` still passes (update it if it pins entry
  keys).
- renumber stale-copy: two otherwise equal histories that differ only in an
  unknown key are not treated as the same record.

Mutation-check each new test (break the code, see it fail, restore).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `slicer start S44 --render --strict` in the slice worktree.
2. Red tests above.
3. `HistoryEntry` extra-key handling and `Validate` changes.
4. Lint checks; docs and CHANGELOG.
5. Record each interface choice the slice leaves open with
   `slicer catalog add --kind decision` and a one-line reason (C32).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
From the worktree root:

```sh
. scripts/env.sh
go test ./...
go vet ./...
gofmt -l cmd internal          # prints nothing
go build -o .cache/bin/adj ./cmd/adj
.cache/bin/adj lint            # this repo's store: clean
```

Also by hand on a `t.TempDir`-style scratch store under `.cache/tmp`: a
record file with an unknown event and key; `adj list`, `adj show --json`,
`adj lint` (warnings, exit 0), `adj decide` keeps the entry.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Branch `s44` in worktree `../adjudicate-s44`. Do not commit; the orchestrator
commits after the gate passes.
